subject: Pen test findings: credential exposure & rotation plan (status + ETA)
messages:
From: Jared Lee <security@acme-corp.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: Acuity Security <reporting@acuitysec.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pen test engagement - credential exposure findings

Evelyn,

Thanks again for partnering on the pen test. Our InfoSec team flagged three high-priority items in Acuity's report that we need remediation evidence for before the week of 8/23:

- Hard-coded AWS keys found in lambda function "ingest-user-events" (finding A-1)
- Service accounts without enforced MFA (finding A-3)
- Insufficient auth audit logging for token exchange endpoints (finding A-7)

Can you confirm planned mitigations, expected completion dates, and whether you'll provide logs/evidence (redacted) for each finding? Acme needs this to close their internal ticket and proceed with the integration.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

—Jared
Security Engineer, Acme Corp
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
To: Jared Lee <security@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Acuity Security <reporting@acuitysec.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pen test engagement - credential exposure findings

Jared —

Thanks for the clear list. TL;DR: we have scoped fixes, assigned owners, and can provide redacted evidence for each item. High-level plan and ETAs below. We are attaching the formal remediation plan (credential-rotation-plan-2026-08.xlsx) and will upload logs to the secure drive link.

Action summary (owners / ETA):
- A-1 (hard-coded AWS keys in ingest-user-events): rotate credentials, remove keys from code, add repo secret scan
  - Owner: Karthik Iyer (Platform)
  - ETA: 2026-08-20 (deploy + proof of rotation)
  - Evidence: commit IDs, PR diff, key rotation ticket, redacted CloudTrail event showing new key usage

- A-3 (service accounts lacking MFA): enforce session policies + rotate to IAM roles or OIDC where possible
  - Owner: Mina Haddad (Security Ops)
  - ETA: 2026-08-22 (policy rollout + verification)
  - Evidence: IAM policy change log, policy-id, screenshot of console policy, verification script output

- A-7 (auth audit logging gaps): enable structured auth logs for /token and /exchange endpoints, backfill where available, and wire logs into retention bucket
  - Owner: Rishi Malhotra (SRE)
  - ETA: 2026-08-22 (pipeline + sample logs)
  - Evidence: sample logs (redacted), deployment hash for logging agent, DataDog dashboard snapshot

We will also include a short writeup explaining why these fixes close the relevant Acuity findings and include a signed attestation from our security lead. Let me know if any additional formats are needed (Syslog, raw CloudTrail, or SIEM exports).

Regards,
Evelyn Hart
Head of Security Programs
Redwood Inference

Attachment: credential-rotation-plan-2026-08.xlsx
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Jared Lee <security@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Acuity Security <reporting@acuitysec.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Aug 2026 15:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pen test engagement - credential exposure findings

Quick status update from Platform (A-1):

- Replaced hard-coded keys in ingest-user-events with parameterized secrets from Secrets Manager. No code paths now contain plaintext credentials.
- Rotation completed for the affected AWS access keys (rotated at 2026-08-20T22:04:00Z).
- PR: repo:redwood/core-service/pulls/1789 (includes the removal and test coverage).
- Evidence uploaded to the shared remediation folder: sha1-of-deploy.txt, rotation-ticket-#7123, and redacted CloudTrail entry showing the first usage of the new key.

Next steps: I will run a branch-level secret-scan across the mono-repo and create a periodic check in CI to fail builds on detected secrets. ETA for the CI check is 2026-09-03.

-Karthik
Senior Platform Engineer

Attachment: (none)
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Jared Lee <security@acme-corp.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 21 Aug 2026 10:31:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pen test engagement - credential exposure findings

Jared —

A-3 (service accounts) update: we scoped all service principals that Acuity flagged and converted two long-lived service accounts to short-lived role assumptions via OIDC. MFA enforcement for human-accessible service accounts is now enforced via our identity provider policy.

Evidence that we uploaded to the remediation folder: iam-policy-change-20260821.json (redacted), policy-arn: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:policy/Enforce-MFA-Interactive, and the policy application runbook.

ETA: 2026-08-22 for audit verification. If Acme needs a signed attestation for each account, we can provide one on request.

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Security Ops Manager

Attachment: auth-policy-audit-sample.txt
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Jared Lee <security@acme-corp.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 22 Aug 2026 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pen test engagement - credential exposure findings

Jared —

A-7 (auth logging) final verification: structured auth logs now emit tenant_id, request_id, auth_method, and outcome fields for /token and /exchange. We tested end-to-end and produced a redacted 24-hour sample (auth-logs-sample-20260822.tar.gz) showing both denied and successful flows. Retention retention policy was applied to the logs S3 bucket with 365-day retention as requested by Acme.

I also added a DataDog dashboard snapshot (DD-board-Auth-Audit-20260822.png) to the drive link and annotated the findings with the correlating log lines. We believe this closes A-7 but happy to walk through the logs with Acme's team.

Regards,
Rishi Malhotra
Senior SRE

Attachments: redwood-acuity-pentest-2026-08.pdf; auth-logs-sample-20260822.tar.gz
